_comment_usage: Copy this file to config_batch.json and modify the values
_comment_llm_provider: Available: openai (or OpenAI), qwen, deepseek. Case-insensitive.
_comment_llm_model: Model name depends on provider. Examples: gpt-4-0125-preview, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022, llama3.1:8b
_comment_api_key: Your LLM provider API key. Keep this secure!
_comment_xes_file_path: Absolute or relative path to the XES event log file
description: This is a process for handling employee declarations
_comment_description: Description of the process being analyzed
goal: Optimize process efficiency and reduce processing time
_comment_ppi_category: Type of PPIs to generate: 'time', 'occurrency', or 'both'
_comment_output_folder: Folder where results will be saved
_comment_num_runs_per_activity: Number of times to run PPI generation for each activity
_comment_activities: List of activities to analyze. Use ['all'] for all activities, or specify: ['Activity 1', 'Activity 2']
_comment_max_level1_iterations: Maximum iterations for Level 1 error correction (re-translation)
_comment_max_level2_iterations: Maximum iterations for Level 2 error correction (JSON fixing)
_comment_save_debug_logs: Set to true to save all OpenAI prompts and responses for debugging
